youtube.title: How to Start a Business with NO MONEY (The Deku Strategy) #Shorts
youtube.description:
Just like starting Quirkless, you don't need massive capital to build your legacy. All you need is a high-value skill that solves a real, painful problem. Learn how to pre-sell your solution, validate your business idea before spending a dime, and let your very first client fund your growth.

Master the ultimate bootstrapping strategy for beginner entrepreneurs. Turn your skills into a profitable business without taking on debt or needing initial investment.

In business, waiting for capital is often just an excuse for inaction.

Just like Izuku Midoriya starting from ground zero, your greatest asset isn't capital—it's strategic analysis and skill execution.

To boot-strap a company with $0:
1. Identify a high-pain problem.
2. Master or package the skill that solves it.
3. Pre-sell the solution before building the product.

By letting your first clients finance your product development, you eliminate financial risk and achieve immediate product-market fit.
